title: Migrate to the native cf toolchain
what: Use the pinned cf CLI, cloudflare.config.ts and Cloudflare Vite plugin v2 beta with Vite+. Declare the PiDurable and SandboxContainer SQLite Durable Objects, the DELIVERY Queue and every server secret in the native config, remove the duplicate Node/Miniflare runtime launcher so vp run dev is the only local startup path, and verify authenticated HTTP with restart persistence. Do not deploy during this migration.

acceptance.text: Use pinned cf CLI and Vite plugin v2 beta with typed Cloudflare configuration and no Wrangler configuration
Declare session, job and sandbox Durable Objects with SQLite storage in native Build Output
Remove the custom runtime launcher, its package scripts and documentation
Verify vp run dev with actual authenticated HTTP and persistence across restart
Pass the full Vite+ verification suite and native cf deployment dry run without uploading
